mapper.sql: SELECT COALESCE(cp.company_post_id, p.post_id) AS post_id, COALESCE(cp.company_id, p.user_id) AS user_id, COALESCE(cp.company_post_title, p.post_title) AS post_title, COALESCE(cp.company_post_content, p.post_content) AS post_content, COALESCE(cp.updated_at, p.post_date) AS post_date, p.target_type, p.target_id FROM post p LEFT JOIN company_post cp ON p.post_id = cp.post_id
mapper.select: SELECT COALESCE(cp.company_post_id, p.post_id) AS post_id, COALESCE(cp.company_id, p.user_id) AS user_id, COALESCE(cp.company_post_title, p.post_title) AS post_title, COALESCE(cp.company_post_content, p.post_content) AS post_content, COALESCE(cp.updated_at, p.post_date) AS post_date, p.target_type, p.target_id FROM post p LEFT JOIN company_post cp ON p.post_id = cp.post_id WHERE COALESCE(cp.company_post_id, p.post_id) = #{postId}
